registryBasis: The official Gombe Geographic Information Systems (GOGIS) site identifies GOGIS as the Gombe State land-administration GIS and describes land titling, property registration, mapping, data management and map-production functions. This evidences a local/state custodian relevant to the WUP point, not an open parcel database or citywide geometry coverage.
blocker: Bounded anonymous review of the first-party GOGIS website and Map Shop pages exposed institutional/procedure information and downloadable forms, but no public JavaScript map configuration, parcel API, schema/CRS response, safe native parcel ID, or parcel polygon. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
